verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents self-hosting with 'full control over data location' and one-click migrations between Appwrite Cloud and self-hosted (and from Firebase/Supabase/NHost), plus a CLI that manages/exports resources (rows, files, users) into JSON files, all supporting data portability and open formats. However, there is no single documented 'export all my data' feature or explicit open-format export guarantee spanning all resource types. Missing for 10: an explicit full-data export/backup command or documented complete data-portability workflow, and independent verification that migrations/export are lossless and comprehensive.
